workstream_gates.can_if: Exact connector ICD + mass/inertia/actuation/bounds + relative approach + contact model + fail-safe are bound

explicit_non_derivables: No real bulk density from taxonomic classification
No material deposit location or mass percent from S-type spectral class
No validated surface gravity map without PDS mesh and mass
No touchdown or excavation loads without instrumented geology and dynamics
No GMAT trajectory or spacecraft delta-v from asteroid flyby alone
No power/storage cycle from conceptual resonators, Free Flow or Solar Hull without tests
No legitimate legal ownership of celestial resources from internal registry
